note: Source-supported habitat regions added to existing planets. Original membership and encounters are preserved. A region shows its own recovered background (backgroundMapId equals originalMapId) where the official H5 art and road mask exist; otherwise it reuses its parent map's, and ownArtwork says why: flash-only maps have no H5 resource table, only the named Flash map.
